title: Schedule of Servicing Fees: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Re-opened Installment Rate Schedule
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — percentage applied to an installment re-opened by a returned payment.**

The percentage applied to the re-opened amount is 3 percent when the contract shows at least 18 installments satisfied and no late charge was assessed on the contract in the last 12 calendar months; it is 4 percent when the contract shows at least 12 installments satisfied and no more than one late charge was assessed on the contract in the last 12 calendar months, where the first condition is not met; in every other case no rate from this schedule applies and the percentage is the product's late-charge percentage of the unpaid installment.

| Installments satisfied on the contract | Late charges on the contract in the last 12 calendar months | Percentage applied to the re-opened amount |
|---|---|---|
| 18 or more | none | 3.0 percent |
| 18 or more | exactly one | 4.0 percent |
| 12 to 17 | none or one | 4.0 percent |
| 12 or more | two or more | no rate from this schedule |
| fewer than 12 | any | no rate from this schedule |

**Counting.** The installments satisfied are the count the contract record shows. The late charges counted are the late charge entries on the contract's ledger. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- 18 installments satisfied, no late charge in the last 12 calendar months: 3.0 percent. With 17 satisfied and no late charge: 4.0 percent.
- 12 installments satisfied and one late charge in the last 12 calendar months: 4.0 percent; 11 satisfied and no late charge: no rate from this schedule.
- A late charge dated the 20th of a month, viewed on the 20th of the same month twelve months later, lies 12 whole months back and is outside the last 12 calendar months; viewed on the 19th of that month it is 11 whole months back and is inside.
